notice: A relation appears only where a pinned public source documents it. Hosting is not integration; a shared dataset family does not make observations comparable; connectivity in this graph says nothing about scientific agreement or validity. The absence of a documented relation does not prove that no relation exists.

verification.statement: Every cited passage was read at its pinned commit by an AI assistant (PR #22 and this freeze). That is not human verification. Per-relationship human verification (v0.4 acceptance criterion K2) is pending and is recorded in SPEC.md §13.8.

classes.label: Technical dependency
classes.definition: One item's code or data pipeline reads or loads another item's artifact, as documented by the dependent item's own pinned source.

classes.label: Structural
classes.definition: Containment or attachment documented in a record: a repository hosts an item, or an item has an output. Never implies data exchange.

classes.label: Methodological
classes.definition: An item applies a named method or uses a dataset product, or is a declared extension of another item's research design.

classes.label: Territorial
classes.definition: An item is situated in a territory, or a territory lies within another, as a source states. Overlap is never computed or inferred.

predicates.label: depends on
predicates.definition: The source item cannot run without the target item's artifact at a pinned version.
predicates.required_evidence: A pinned source in the dependent item's own repository that names the target and the version it loads.
predicates.limits: Says nothing about the scientific validity of either item. A dependency on a pinned version is not a dependency on the target's current or dossier version.
inference_rules: What the dependent item may claim does not grow because of the dependency.
Never inferred from shared authorship, territory or vocabulary.

predicates.label: reads outputs of
predicates.definition: The source item ingests a published output of the target item through a documented extraction.
predicates.required_evidence: A pinned provenance record in the consumer's own repository naming the producer, the producer version and the fields read.
predicates.limits: The consumer inherits the producer's claim ceiling for the values it reads. Consumption does not validate the producer, and the producer's conclusions do not become the consumer's.
inference_rules: Only the documented subset is consumed; never generalise to all outputs.
Labels or verdicts not stated as consumed are not consumed.

predicates.label: hosts
predicates.definition: The target item's files live inside the source item's repository.
predicates.required_evidence: A pinned source showing where the hosted item lives, or the v0.3 `hosts` field.
predicates.limits: Hosting is co-location of files. It does not imply that the host's application reads, displays or depends on the hosted item.
inference_rules: Never read as data exchange or integration.
Where a source states isolation, a documented non-relationship is recorded.

predicates.label: has output
predicates.definition: The output belongs to the item (the `output.research_id` field, unchanged).
predicates.limits: Publication type, editorial status and identifier are separate facts; none is a quality grade.

predicates.label: extends
predicates.definition: The source item is a declared research extension of the target, reusing its setting or infrastructure under its own question.
predicates.required_evidence: A pinned statement in the extension naming the base study and the boundary between them.
predicates.limits: An extension does not revise, confirm or refute the base study. Questions, results and outputs stay separate.
inference_rules: Never combine the two items' results or verdicts.

predicates.label: applies method
predicates.definition: The item's methodology source states that it applies the named method.
predicates.limits: Two items applying one method do not share configuration, inputs, calibration or validity.
inference_rules: ‘Shares a method’ is never stored; it is read only from separate applies-method relations, each with its own source.

predicates.label: uses dataset
predicates.definition: The item's source states that it uses a product of the named dataset family; the relation records which extract, product or vintage.
predicates.required_evidence: A pinned source naming the dataset and, where stated, the extract, product or retrieval date.
predicates.limits: Items using one dataset family usually use different extracts, products, dates or areas. A shared family does not make their observations comparable and does not establish agreement.
inference_rules: Read the extract on each relation before comparing items.

predicates.label: situated in
predicates.definition: The item's source places its study area, network or case in the territory (the `territory_ids` field).
predicates.limits: A territory label is not geometry. Two items in one territory did not necessarily study the same area, period or phenomenon.
inference_rules: Never infer overlap or comparability from a shared territory.

predicates.label: lies within
predicates.definition: A source places the smaller territory inside the larger one.
predicates.required_evidence: A source stating the containment; the Atlas intersects no geometry.
predicates.limits: Containment only. Overlap between sibling territories is not computed and not asserted.
inference_rules: Territories inside one parent are not thereby adjacent or overlapping.
